§3§lPreparation and use§r
Bind the ME Quantum Terminal to a quantized controller, then right-click the target position to place a Quantum Node. It connects adjacent AE2 devices to the anchor network through a virtual bridge. Tick this quest after understanding placement and bridging.

§3§lChannels and power draw§r
Each bridge uses a dense connection carrying up to §132§r channels; the node itself consumes no channel. Default idle draw is §110 AE/t§r. §2Virtual bridging supports cross-dimension connections without ordinary cable routing distance limits§r.

§3§lChunk loading and removal§r
§cThe anchor dimension and chunk must already be loaded; Quantum Nodes do not load their anchor.§r Shift-right-click a node with the Quantum Terminal to remove it.
